copy.heading: Arrival kit

items: One front door key. You have one already. It is on the keyring behind the ball marker.
One map of the house, showing the kitchen, the washing machine and the room where the family sit in the evening.
One calendar, showing family events in pen and golf in pencil.
One pair of indoor shoes. They do not have spikes.
One copy of this programme, which is not to be used to practise putting into a mug.

blocks.label: Case notes (Sue), Day 3
blocks.text: He asked where we keep the Calpol. At two in the morning. We've lived here six years.

body: On arrival you will be issued with the following. Tick each item once you have located it.
